scanchk.finding: p4l has ONE HBM3E stack a die: 16 regional controllers dsfd_ctrl_rg2 x 2 pseudo-channels = 32 PCs = one HBM3/3E stack, one PHY with an 8.5 mm north face (s81_dv_1016/SPEC.md 0b-p4g); tput_recheck counts 440 stacks for 440 dies
scanchk.composed_scan_rate: the 10-18 composition charges the 10-09 L20 scan, 5,987 cycles for 71.3 MB on 4 dies = 3.76 stacks a die
scanchk.note: lane S81-SCANCHK had not reported when this study ran; this is this lane's own check

expert_load.method: fit LPT equal-count placement on 60 random traces (seed 20261018), evaluate per-group load on the other 60; contiguous = experts 0..E/D-1 in group 0 etc.; load = routed-expert hits over all decode positions (multi-user steady state)
expert_load.source: /tmp/claude-review-20261003/mtp_q/router/router_full.pt sha256 86a9d9dab... (MTP-STATS source; 120 agentic greedy traces, 9,455 decode positions, top-6 of 384, 40 layers)

applied.note: S81 row-shards every matrix over all frames of a TP4 stage (SPEC: rows/128 a frame), so routing cannot unbalance dies INSIDE a stage; only the split of a layer's 384 experts over its ~2.4 stages matters (3 groups)
